desc: When heading out, grab bars that pack a protein punch! Fuel your family on adventures with Nature Valley Protein Smoothie Tropical Blend Flavored Chewy Bars. With 10g protein in every serving, these chewy bars are like a tropical-tasting protein smoothie you can eat. Each protein bar is made with roasted peanuts, crunchy almonds, dried mango, cranberries, and other delicious ingredients, with an irresistible yogurt flavored bottom coating. These gluten free bars contain no artificial flavors or artificial colors, and no high fructose corn syrup. This box contains five individual snack bars for a flavorful on the go treat that's ideal for adults and kids alike. Keep some in your pantry as a tasty lunch box snack, or a food that's quick and easy to take along for hiking, camping, road trips, and beyond. At Nature Valley, we believe that what you put in is what you get out. So wherever the moment takes you and your family, you can rely on our great-tasting snacks to help keep you going.
features:
Features

10g of Protein per Bar

Provides a solid protein boost to keep you fueled and full throughout the day.

Berry Blend Flavor

Combines real dried blueberries and cranberries with a creamy yogurt-style coating for a fruity, satisfying taste.

Gluten-Free

Made without wheat or gluten-containing ingredients, suitable for gluten-sensitive diets.

Chewy, Nutty Texture

Includes roasted peanuts and almonds for a crunchy base and chewy consistency.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors

Crafted with wholesome ingredients and no high-fructose corn syrup.

Individually Wrapped

Perfect for lunchboxes, gym bags, hikes, or snack drawers—grab-and-go made easy.

Benefits

Satisfying and Energizing

Offers a balanced combination of protein, fiber, and natural ingredients to curb hunger and provide lasting energy.

Great for Busy Lifestyles

Whether you’re on the move, at the office, or heading to the gym, it’s a convenient way to snack smart.

Tastes Like a Treat

The yogurt-style coating and berry flavor create a dessert-like experience—without the guilt.

Supports Muscle Recovery

The protein content makes it ideal post-workout or between meals for recovery and satiety.

Kid-Friendly Option

Flavorful and nutritious, making it suitable for both kids and adults.
ingredients:
Roasted Peanuts, Almonds, Soy Protein Isolate, Sugar, Chicory Root Extract, Corn Syrup, Palm Kernel Oil, Dried Mango, Fructose, Whey Protein Isolate, Rice Starch, Vegetable Glycerin, Cranberries, Cranberry Powder, Corn Starch, Yogurt Powder (whey protein concentrate, nonfat milk, cultures), Soy Lecithin, Canola Oil, Nonfat Milk, Salt, Natural Flavor, Sunflower Oil.

Contains peanut, almond, soy, milk and coconut ingredients.
